features.name: climb_rate_norm
features.description: Standardized climb rate using training mean and std, providing a smooth linear projection axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered and scaled climbRate improves linear margin geometry.

features.name: pitch_roll_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of current pitch and absolute roll capturing aircraft attitude severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of attitude variables gives a useful margin direction.

features.name: pq_rotational_magnitude
features.description: Euclidean magnitude of pitch-rate p and roll-rate q, a continuous severity measure of rotational motion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth nonnegative severity score useful for linear SVM.

features.name: diff_clb_ratio
features.description: Ratio of climb-rate change to its acceleration term, capturing dynamic response.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features expose nonlinear interactions in a form linear SVM can exploit.

features.name: se_mean_norm
features.description: Average of all SeTime sensor readings standardized against the global Se mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth aggregate elevator timing signal as a single linear feature.
features.formula: ((SeTime1 + SeTime2 + SeTime3 + SeTime4 + SeTime5 + SeTime6 + SeTime7 + SeTime8 + SeTime9 + SeTime10 + SeTime11 + SeTime12 + SeTime13 + SeTime14) / 14.0 - 0.022) / 0.00688

features.name: se_time_range
features.description: Spread between max and min of SeTime sensors, indicating timing variability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures variation in sensor timings as a continuous severity feature.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(SeTime1, SeTime4), np.maximum(SeTime8, SeTime12)), SeTime14) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(SeTime1, SeTime4), np.minimum(SeTime8, SeTime12)), SeTime14)

features.name: diff_se_time_l1
features.description: L1 norm of all non-zero diffSeTime variables, capturing total elevator timing change.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous nonnegative magnitude useful for linear separability.
features.formula: np.abs(diffSeTime1) + np.abs(diffSeTime3) + np.abs(diffSeTime5) + np.abs(diffSeTime7) + np.abs(diffSeTime9) + np.abs(diffSeTime11) + np.abs(diffSeTime13)

features.name: climb_pitch_interaction
features.description: Interaction between climbRate and curPitch capturing climb dynamics, scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cross-feature interaction surfaced for linear model.

features.name: alpha_severity
features.description: Deviation of angle of attack alpha from its training mean, log-compressed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth deviation severity score useful for linear classifier.

features.name: roll_rate_signed_severity
features.description: Signed severity of roll rate change combining direction and magnitude scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves sign while compressing magnitude for linear margin.

features.name: stability_judgment_score
features.description: Semantic stability assessment combining low absolute pitch rate, low absolute roll rate change, and small climb deviation. Computed as a weighted smooth score where higher values mean more stable flight conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable stability axis aligned with linear SVM decision boundary.

features.name: control_effort_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of control effort combining elevator deflection Se and its timing variability relative to typical values. Higher means more aggressive control input.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures control aggressiveness as a smooth linear-friendly score.
